name: 1497-solodecode-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite -- bf16, ungated, ~31 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 120 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. streams=1 is declared, not a starting point to search from: the engine uses its compiled decode path only at batch sizes at or below `max-torch-compile-bs`, which is 1 here.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts exactly 128 tokens, generations exactly 512 with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A single-user drafting assistant generating 512-token replies from short prompts, one request at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit 2854a5ea9fbb31165936f633ab99915dec760f8d (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.3.1.post3-10-g2854a5ea9fb). Flat `key: value` only; an indented block is skipped, not merged.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
enable-torch-compile: true
max-torch-compile-bs: 1
disable-radix-cache: true

# 4096 is the checkpoint's native window and is load-bearing: it advertises 163840 positions, and
# the request table the engine allocates on the device is (max requests) x (context length + 8)
# int32, which at the advertised window is terabytes and the server never starts. The longest
# request here is 128 + 512 = 640 tokens.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
